items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: when I started out at my brother Sidney... we'd play out in the lake

ctx.x: But did you play mostly uptown when you first came here?

Yeah, because I was living uptown at that time. Doing my brother sitting at that time before he started out. Uh-huh. Yeah, we used to play uptown mostly. I would job uptown. And we played a lot of jobs downtown, too. Where at? Well, most of our job when we started out, when I started out at my brother Sidney, well, like I said, it was mostly party jobs and dance hall jobs. We'd play out in the lake, you know, like that, and excretion yards, like that.
Different places like that. Did you ever play around customizing the basin? No, no, no. Where all the fast women were in? No, no, no.
